risk_note: RV2 money (union/**). Taobao price mapping per D33 (BR-PRICE-02 detail): a pure function from the discount price, the estimated net price and the promotion detail; items classified by NFKC-normalised names into member / coupon / platform discount / unknown with the 08 default lists; final = net + member items, coupon = coupon items, price = final + coupon; checks 1-5 and validity in the 08 order, stopping at the first hit; unknown_promo (default unavailable) and basis (default promotion_path; coupon_only only by owner decision) as parameters; coupon id string sorted and comma-joined; PRICE_CALC_DIFF / PRICE_PROMO_UNKNOWN (name only) through an optional alert callback. UnionItem gains optional coupon_ids / price_status / price_anomaly_reason, present only with a value; an anomaly zeroes the three prices so any consumer fails closed; isPriceAnomaly exported. Demo adapter taobao data goes through it, with price_anomaly / unknown_promo scenarios for taobao only. Amounts only through @couli/money. Config wiring left as TODO (followups F-36). Written by hand. Orchestrator edit decided 2026-10-06 (couli-runs/B1-04r/decision-orchestrator.md): the skeleton guard refuses the rule-test commit's two-line dispatch in the existing DemoUnionAdapter.#scenario, so it moved to the implementation, and [AC-B1-04r-DEMO#3] turns a rejection into a value so the red is an assertion (expectations unchanged).
